title: North Macedonia and Switzerland Face Off in Nations League
seoTitle: North Macedonia vs Switzerland: Nations League
subtitle: The match in the tournament brings together national teams with confirmed lineups and key absences.
excerpt: Get the details of the Nations League match between North Macedonia and Switzerland, including lineups and team news.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: BBC, blue News, Министерство за внатрешни работи
contentHtml:
The Switzerland national team faces North Macedonia away from home to kick off their Nations League campaign. The clash is highly anticipated by fans and brings key updates to both teams' lineups for the match.

North Macedonia Lineup

The North Macedonia team takes the pitch under manager Goce Sedloski with S. Dimitrievski in goal. The defense features S. Herrera, V. Musliu, G. Zajkov, and B. Ilievski. In midfield, the team features E. Elmas, captain E. Bardhi, M. Gashtarov, and T. Kostadinov. The attack is formed by E. Rastoder and B. Miovski.

Switzerland Lineup

Under the guidance of manager Murat Yakin, the Swiss national team has G. Kobel in goal and a defensive line composed of R. Rodríguez, captain M. Akanji, N. Elvedi, and Z. Athekame. In midfield, R. Freuler and A. Jashari play as defensive midfielders, while D. Ndoye, J. Manzambi, and F. Rieder complete the midfield. Up front, Z. Amdouni is chosen to lead the line.

Updates and debuts in the Swiss team

The match marks Zachary Athekame's debut for the Switzerland senior national team. The player operates at right-back, filling the vacancy left by the absences of Silvan Widmer, Luca Jaquez, and Denis Zakaria. Another update is the presence of Ardon Jashari in midfield, earning the chance to showcase his skills alongside Remo Freuler.

Absences in the Switzerland national team

The Swiss team faces significant absences for this fixture. Players like Silvan Widmer, Luca Jaquez, and Denis Zakaria are not participating in the current training camp. In addition to them, captain Granit Xhaka will miss the team's first matches of the competition, opening up space for new midfield options.
